title: Three-Winding Transformer
text: Compute sum of RF signals; {Inductance L1} sets the inductance value of first inductor, {Inductance L2} sets the inductance value of second inductor, {Inductance L3} sets the inductance value of third inductor, {Coefficient of coupling K12} sets the coupling coefficient of first and second, {Coefficient of coupling K13} sets the coupling coefficient of first and third and {Coefficient of coupling K23} sets the coupling coefficient of second and third. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Inductance L1
params.values: Inductance value of first inductor 1e-6 H (default) | nonnegative scalar integer

params.name: Inductance L2
params.values: Inductance value of second inductor 1e-6 H (default) | nonnegative scalar integer

params.name: Inductance L3
params.values: Inductance value of third inductor 1e-6 H (default) | nonnegative scalar integer

params.name: Coefficient of coupling K12
params.values: Coupling coefficient of first and second inductors 0.9 (default) | nonnegative scalar integer

params.name: Coefficient of coupling K13
params.values: Coupling coefficient of first and third inductors 0.9 (default) | nonnegative scalar integer

params.name: Coefficient of coupling K23
params.values: Coupling coefficient of second and third inductors 0.9 (default) | nonnegative scalar integer
